description: This file defines a Grain class 'GeneratorTestDerivedFromFSharpInterfaceInExternalAssemblyGrain' that implements an interface for testing code generation related to F# interface in an external assembly. It includes asynchronous methods 'Echo' and 'MultipleParameterEcho' returning task-based results.

classes.name: GeneratorTestDerivedFromFSharpInterfaceInExternalAssemblyGrain
classes.description: A Grain class implementing an interface for testing code generation involving F# interfaces in external assemblies.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Returns the input integer wrapped in a Task.

methods.name: MultipleParameterEcho
methods.description: Accepts a string and an int, returns a tuple with both wrapped in a Task.
